sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Chandra Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1- Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State.

2- The instant bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 249 of 2021, under Section 376 of I.P.C.,
Police Station-Barhaj, District-Deoria, during the pendency of trial.
3-

As per the prosecution case in brief, informant who is father of the victim lodged F.I.R. on 29.11.2021 against the present applicant alleging inter-alia that on 28.11.2021 when the informant along with Awadhesh Tiwari had gone to his farm, at that time, the applicant barged into his house from the roof and coaxing his daughter committed misdeed with her.

Pashupati Nath Tiwari @ Jugnu vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129749592/
1 4- It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that during investigation, when the statement of parents of the victim were recorded, they have stated inter-alia that the victim is mentally retarded and she used to go here and there.

entities.text: Pashupati Nath Tiwari @ Jugnu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: referring the ossification test report of the victim dated 07.12.2021, it is pointed out that she is aged about 21 years and her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded by her gestures and indications given by her, but after culmination of investigation she has not been made witness of the charge sheet filed against the applicant.
The father, mother and sister of the victim have been made witnesses of the charge sheet but they are not eye-witnesses of the incident.

It is also pointed out that before the trial Court, statement of father of the victim has been recorded as PW-1, in which he has not supported the prosecution case and has been declared hostile at the request of prosecution.

Referring his statement, much emphasis has been given by pointing out that, father of the victim has admitted in his statement that some people of the village are inimical with the applicant, therefore, on their persuasion F.I.R. has been lodged against the applicant at the behest of mother and sister of the victim.
Lastly, it is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that there is no chance of the applicant of fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

The applicant is languishing in jail since 29.11.2021 having no criminal history to his credit and in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in the early disposal of the case.

5- On the other hand, learned A.G.A. for the State opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that though the father of the victim has not supported the prosecution case, but mother and sister of the victim have supported the prosecution case.

6- Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that neither the victim has been made witness of the charge-sheet nor she has been produced before the trial Court for getting her statement recorded and there was major contradiction with regard to statement of PW-1-Thakur Tiwari as well as in the statements of PW-2 Rama Devi and PW-3 Archana Tiwari recorded before the trial Court.

7- Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, I am of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

8- Let the applicant-Pashupati Nath Tiwari @ Jugnu, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) That the applicant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.
(ii) That the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the Pashupati Nath Tiwari @ Jugnu vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129749592/
2 evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the applicant shall not involve in any criminal activity.

entities.text: Pashupati Nath Tiwari @ Jugnu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iv) The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned before the release of the applicant on bail.
9- In case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail of the applicant.
10- It is made clear that the observations contained in the instant order are confined to the issue of bail only and shall not affect the merit of the trial.
